newsitem.title: USA: Terra to redeem non-converting units.
newsitem.headline: Terra to redeem non-converting units.

text.p: Terra Nitrogen Co LP said that on May 27 it will redeem all senior preference units that have not converted to common units.

Holders of the senior units have until the close of business March 31 to convert them into common units. Holders of non-converting senior units of record on April 1 will be sent a redemption notice outlining the procedure.
The redemption price is $21.50 per unit, exclusive of any cash distribution.
Terra manufactures and markets nitrogen fertilizer products.
